tolerance_rationale: Bhava bala builds on shad bala (bhava adhipathi bala) plus bhava dig/drishti bala, all summed over arcsec-level planet/cusp longitudes that differ between Python's JPL and the TS Moshier/WASM ephemerides. After the saptavargaja D-2 and raasi-drishti-houses structural fixes, the worst cell differs by 0.5 (~1.2% rel); prior structural divergence was 10-30 units. Tolerance kept below the structural-bug magnitude.
